ports.description: List of port configurations for mbtserver to listen on. Each entry specifies a port number and optional bind IP.

number.description: TCP port number to bind to.

bind_ip.description: Optional IP address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1'). If omitted, binds to all interfaces.

model_dir.description: Directory where mbtserver stores and loads trained tagger models and cached data.

dict_file.description: Path to the system-wide MBT dictionary file (binary format, read-only).

threads.description: Number of worker threads for handling concurrent requests. Adjust based on CPU cores.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed per listening port.

connection_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) before a client connection is closed.

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging (true/false). Not recommended for production unless troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout instead.

extra_headers.description: Custom HTTP response headers (key-value map) to add to all responses.

allowed_subnets.description: List of allowed client IP subnets (CIDR). If empty or omitted, all IPs are allowed.

disabled_features.description: List of tagger features to disable globally (e.g., 'nbest', 'features', 'morph'). Only disable if not needed and for performance/security.

items.description: Name of a tagger feature to disable.
